name: Log + Deadlift Peak
subtitle: 31 October 2026 competition peak
notes: The empty competition log is 80 kg. The peak now uses one focused log exposure on the main upper day, limited back-off work, and rotating strongman events on Saturdays to keep training varied while still driving the 120 kg log and 280 kg deadlift goals. If nausea, dizziness or unusual weakness returns, stop the hard work rather than forcing the session.
